title: SwarmEvolve Learning-Journal Entry (M15c)
description: One JSON Lines record appended to `data/runs/<track>/<model>/<seed>/journal.jsonl` after every generation (including stalls). The LLM authors the prose fields; scripts/journal.py validates schema + metric grounding before writing. See NEXT_PHASE_PLAN.md §3.X for the full contract. Schema version 1 corresponds to the M15c prototype.

schema_version.description: Journal schema version. The M15c initial release is 1.

generation.description: Zero-indexed generation number within this lineage.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (Zulu). Deterministic injection supports tests by allowing the orchestrator to pass an explicit value.

parent_generation.description: Generation number this entry mutated from. Null on the first generation.

status.description: Terminal pipeline status for this generation. `ok` means code compiled, passed lint, and ran at least one evaluation match. Any other value implies a stall.

fitness.description: Fitness of this generation (higher is better). Null on stall generations.

fitness_delta.description: fitness - parent_fitness. Null on the first generation and on stalls.

outcome_summary.description: One-line natural-language description of the match outcome. Capped to 240 chars.

hypothesis_tested.description: What the LLM set out to verify this generation. Capped to 400 chars.

mechanism_expected.description: Causal story the LLM expected: why the hypothesis should produce the fitness change.

mechanism_observed.description: Causal story the LLM saw (grounded in AAR metrics).

verdict.description: Categorical outcome of the hypothesis. `stalled` is reserved for status != ok.

tactic_tags.description: Lowercase snake_case tags describing the tactical theme. Controlled by `tactic_tags.pattern` below; `scripts/journal.py` canonicalises case/spacing before validating.

advice_to_future_self.description: Actionable prose for the next generation's prompt. Capped to 400 chars to avoid prose dominance (see §3.X.5).

aar_metrics_cited.description: Subset of the M15b AAR structured metrics the LLM chose to ground its analysis on. Keys must exist in the AAR; values must match within 1% relative tolerance (see §3.X.3).

validation.description: Validation result recorded by scripts/journal.py. `metrics_match_aar` is true only when every cited key agrees with the AAR within tolerance.

rewrites.description: Number of rewrite rounds consumed before acceptance (0..2).

notes.description: Optional validator notes; used on fallback entries.

allOf.description: Stalled generations have null fitness and fitness_delta, and verdict=stalled.
